attchmntText: Tata Steel Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording
voiceSummary: Tata Steel Limited has made available the audio-video recording of its 2QFY27 Earnings Discussion. The Board of Directors approved the audited Standalone and unaudited Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, during a meeting held on November 7, 2026. The Earnings Discussion was hosted on the same date at 2:00 p.m. IST. The recording is accessible on the Company's website at https://www.tatasteel.com/investors/financial-performance/analyst-call-recording/. This filing is submitted pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Para A of Part A of Schedule III of the SEBI Listing Regulations, 2015.

attchmntText: Tata Steel Limited has informed the Exchange about acquisition of 38,222 equity shares of face value ₹10/- each in Creative Port Development Private Limited ( CPDPL ) due to conversion of 25,10,830 Optionally Convertible Redeemable Preference Shares of CPDPL, as per terms of issue
voiceSummary: Tata Steel Limited acquired 38,222 equity shares in Creative Port Development Private Limited on November 7, 2026. This acquisition resulted from the conversion of 25,10,830 Optionally Convertible Redeemable Preference Shares. The conversion ratio was one equity share for every 65.69 preference shares. Tata Steel’s equity stake in the subsidiary increased from 51% to 57.5%. The company received a cash payment of ₹6,876.11 for fractional entitlements. Creative Port Development Private Limited remains a subsidiary of Tata Steel. The target entity operates in the transportation and storage sector. No governmental or regulatory approvals were required for this transaction.

attchmntText: Tata Steel Limited has informed the Exchange regarding retirement of Mr. Noel Naval Tata as the Non-Executive, Non-Independent Director and Vice Chairman of the Board
voiceSummary: Tata Steel Limited approved its audited standalone and unaudited consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The statutory auditor issued a qualified opinion due to non-recognition of further fair value reduction for Tata Steel Nederland B.V., which has a carrying value of Rs. 59,078.13 crore. The auditor also highlighted an emphasis of matter regarding the Scheme of Amalgamation with Rujuvalika Investments Limited, approved by the National Company Law Tribunal on October 1, 2026. Mr. Noel Naval Tata, DIN 00024713, will retire as Non-Executive, Non-Independent Director and Vice Chairman effective November 11, 2026. The Board meeting was held on November 7, 2026.

attchmntText: Tata Steel Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Tata Steel submitted a press release and investor presentation to BSE and NSE on November 7, 2026, regarding financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated EBITDA was Rs 10,665 crores for the quarter and Rs 20,035 crores for the half year. Consolidated revenues were Rs 65,436 crores for the quarter and Rs 1,26,231 crores for the half year. India revenues were Rs 42,653 crores for the quarter. Netherlands revenues were €1,395 million. UK revenues were £411 million with an EBITDA loss of £56 million. Capital expenditure was Rs 3,280 crores for the quarter and Rs 6,860 crores for the half year. Net debt stood at Rs 91,423 crores with a net debt to EBITDA ratio of 2.4x. Group liquidity was Rs 40,076 crores.
